== Description ==

[[Brian Fred]] (left, bald, glasses, white Colts sleeveless jersey, left-shoulder tattoo, smiling, shaking hands) and [[Phil Aasen]] (right, grey flat cap, black jacket, back and side to the camera, shaking hands) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
